text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I notice a large crowd while headed to
the
training track and decide to go see
what's
drawing all the attention.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Commentator
text_block_list.text: Challengers! Are you ready to rumble?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Here come the representatives for the
Miho and
Ritto dorms! Taaake your
placeees!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Heehee. ♪ My dear sister, I may be
indebted to
you since you've always
helped me, but that won't
stop me from
giving this challenge my all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Heh. That's what I like to hear. Don't
expect me
to go easy on you either!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Residents
text_block_list.text: Go, Bright, go!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Residents
text_block_list.text: Ryan, let's see those muscles of yours!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's a battle between the dorms! Every
once in a
while, the Miho and Ritto
dorms come together
for a friendly
tussle.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It's really all for show, but it's also my
chance to
prove to Ryan how much I've
grown, which is why
losing isn't an
option.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Commentator
text_block_list.text:
All right! This time, our regularly
scheduled
dormitory showdown will be a
garbage disposal
race!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Over here, we've got a mountain of trash
bags for
each dorm. The first rep to take
out all their trash
wins!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Challengers! On your marks! Get set...
GO!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, yeah! My biceps and triceps are
singing!
Lemme grab some more!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Look at Mejiro Ryan employing her
muscles to
haul a huge number of bags
at once! She's so fast!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Let's see how things are looking on
Mejiro Bright's
side!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oof. You bags looked so cute and
harmless all
snuggled up together, but
you're rather weighty,
aren't you.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Commentator
text_block_list.text:
She seems to be struggling with the
unexpectedly
heavy load! We're starting
to see a gap form
between the
challengers' progress!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Resident A
text_block_list.text: Hehe. We've got this in the bag.

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Resident B
text_block_list.text:
Lifting heavy things? Ryan was born for
this
challenge.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(Phew... I'm halfway done! I'm way ahead
of
Bright, too!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(That doesn't mean I can slow down. I
know Bright
and she's not one to give
up.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(No matter how far behind she falls, she
always
finds a way to close the gap in
the end.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I can't let my guard down! Not if I'm
gonna win
this!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Wheeze... Wheeze...

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Resident A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, is it just me, or has Ryan's pace
slowed a
ton?

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Resident B
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I wonder what's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sprinting back and forth with such heavy
loads
has turned into anaerobic exercise,
and the strain
is gradually wearing away
her endurance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright, on the other hand...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hup, hup, hup. Phew. I think I've finally
gotten
the hang of this.

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Resident A
text_block_list.text:
Bright's still going at the same pace she
started!
This could be anyone's win!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(Don't mind what's happening around
you and
just take things nice and slow...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(I just have to focus on doing what I can
and
going at my own pace. So long as I
keep it up...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(The path will open. A bud will bloom.
Then I can
close the gap between
everyone ahead of me and
surpass
them...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(I made it this far by believing in myself.
That's
why...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: The real challenge begins now, Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Bring it on! I won't lose to you, Bright!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Commentator
text_block_list.text:
I don't believe my eyes! They've come

neck-and-neck, and they're both on
their last
garbage bag! But who's going
to make it back
first?!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Residents
text_block_list.text: Gooo, Ryaaan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Residents
text_block_list.text: You can do this, Bright!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yaaah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Coming in first by a sliver is Ryan!
Today's victory
goes to Miho Dormitory!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Phew! I did it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I lost by a single step. I was able to put
up a good
fight against Ryan, but...

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Residents
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Residents
text_block_list.text:
Nice work, Bright! You looked so cool
out there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The gathered spectators give them a
rowdy round
of applause, thoroughly
satisfied with their close
competition.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I should've known this would be the
outcome,
considering your strength and
speed, Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The cumulation of all your daily hard
work really
paid off. My respect for you
has grown so much
deeper.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Heheh. I could say the same to you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I knew you were gonna come for me in
the end,
but I never expected you to get
that close!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
You might have won this time, but I'll
turn the
tables in our next bout.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Which means I have to polish up my
garbage
disposal skills!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I know! I can start my new training by
carrying all
the garbage from Ritto
Dormitory. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Are you seriously starting your
training right
now?! Bright, you're wild...
